text:
Ava (CEO): quick weekly — verticals: growth, stability, and a small policy change. TL;DR: one customer-impacting incident this week (resolved), GA prep for Private, and a tightening of our EU default retention. please read and act on the asks below.

Ava (CEO): 1) Incident summary: Tue 09:12-09:57 UTC we had degraded serving in ap-southeast for hosted API due to an autoscaler race on shard allocation. ~45 minutes; ~2.3% of requests errored or timed out. No data leak. Root cause: duplicate scale-up and KV lock contention.

Ava (CEO): 2) Impact: affected mid-tier customers with long-sequence workloads; two enterprise customers opened tickets. support and success handled comms.

Ava (CEO): 3) Remediation & short-term: rolled a hotfix to the autoscaler at 09:50; increased Canary coverage; temporary cap on burst scaling in ap-southeast.

Ava (CEO): 4) Action items: SRE to own the postmortem and run a tabletop by Friday; Eng to add a deterministic lock to shard allocation; Product to coordinate customer follow-ups and provide a readiness note for Dedicated trials.

Ava (CEO): 5) Metrics snapshot: p95 latency (text gen) 180ms (flat week), infra cost per 1M tokens -12% (good), hosted error-rate spike during incident only. GA readiness for Private: legal/compliance checklist 85% complete.

Ava (CEO): 6) Policy change (effective next Tuesday): default EU-hosted data retention moves from 90 -> 30 days for new signups; existing customers unchanged unless they opt-in. Private customers can still choose retention via contract/KMS. Reason: reduces surface area for compliance and aligns with enterprise asks.

Ava (CEO): asks: - Jesse (SRE): postmortem + mitigation plan by EOD Friday, add runbook entry for autoscaler locking. - Diego (VP Eng): delivery plan for deterministic lock + ETA for patch to prod-wide rollout. - Maya (VP Product): draft customer comms for impacted customers and update Dedicated ramp doc. - Liam (Head of Sales): pause new Dedicated trials for ap-southeast until we validate rollout; inform inbound prospects.

Diego (VP Eng): noted. will schedule an emergency design review for the locking approach this afternoon. ETA for code + tests: 5 business days, can accelerate if we pair with SRE.

Jesse (SRE): taking point on the postmortem. tabletop scheduled Thu 15:00 UTC, invite sent to eng-oncall, platform, and support. runbook PR in flight.

Maya (VP Product): will draft comms today, aim to send to affected customers tomorrow morning. will also update Dedicated checklist with a gating flag for ap-southeast capacity.

Liam (Head of Sales): copying the pause. can we get a one-pager for prospects explaining risk mitigation? I can share in demo calls.

Ava (CEO): one-pager — Maya + Liam coordinate; Diego/Jesse provide short technical blurb we can include.

OpsBot: deploy-notice: autoscaler-hotfix v2.3.7 deployed at 09:50 UTC to ap-southeast. no regressions observed in Canary. :white_check_mark:

Diego (VP Eng): small ask — can we add a temporary routing fallback to eu-west for long sequence jobs if ap-southeast is saturated? will open a PR for traffic policy.

Ava (CEO): yes, approve fallback as a temporary policy. Ops/SRE work with network to set a soft redirect.

Jesse (SRE): noted. will coordinate with networking and enable gradual redirect with canary keys.

Ava (CEO): final notes: thanks everyone for quick triage. overall signal: platform is resilient but please treat this as high priority — our promise is predictable inference. i'll follow up next week with a short readout on mitigations and policy rollout. :rocket: 

Diego (VP Eng): +1

Maya (VP Product): +1

Liam (Head of Sales): thanks, will hold off on trials

Jesse (SRE): postmortem linked here when ready — will ping in #postmortems.
